title: EXChAngE Blue Pass – Discover Cross-Border Aquatic Heritage
description: Explore EXChAngE’s Blue Pass video, connecting aquatic biodiversity and cultural heritage routes in Croatia, Montenegro and Bosnia and Herzegovina.
